info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Loan Collaterals API
info.description: The Manage Loan Collaterals API enables users to efficiently handle collateral associated with loan applications. This endpoint allows for the removal of specific collateral items linked to a loan application, facilitating accurate financial management and reporting. Typical consumers include financial institutions and loan processors who need to maintain up-to-date records of collateral inventories. Use cases include clearing obsolete or redundant collateral items as loans are processed or updated.

delete.summary: Remove a collateral from a loan application.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific collateral associated with a loan application identified by RES-100045. Ensure you have the correct permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the collateral item that needs to be deleted from the loan application identified by RES-100045. Ensure that you provide the necessary identification details within the specified schema to facilitate the correct deletion process.
